description: AICTIONBOT™ handover file by KULIC Advisory (tool 41), built on the Execution Toolkit template T07 (cross-functional action log). Takes the person, the deputy, the absence (away_from, away_to; empty away_to means the person leaves, the first 90 days are covered) and a list of open items (type: approval, contract or deadline, order, invoice, supplier, task; item; due date; value; supplier; deputy; status; note). Returns what must be settled before the last day (approvals tied to the person, deadlines in the absence, overdue items, items without a deputy, in red), what falls due during the absence, later items, contacts, the load per deputy, a five-point handover meeting and the hand-back date. Deterministic, no AI, nothing stored. Needs sign-in: runs with an AICTIONBOT™ Werkbank licence; without a licence one check per connection every 30 days is free (sign in with “Connect without a licence”).

away_from.description: First day of absence, YYYY-MM-DD or DD.MM.YYYY. Default today.

away_to.description: Last day of absence. Leave empty if the person leaves for good.

deputy.description: Deputy or successor for all items without their own.

items.description: Open items: type, item, due, value, supplier, deputy, status, note. German column names work too.

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

name: build_handover_file
title: Handover file when someone leaves or goes on holiday: open approvals, contracts, deadlines, orders, invoices and contacts with a deputy per item
